house.description: School administrators board reporting requirements modified.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Education Policy
House rule 4.20, interim disposition of bills, returned to Education Policy

latest_action.text: House rule 4.20, interim disposition of bills, returned to Education Policy

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to education; modifying Board of School Administrators reporting requirements; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 122A.14, subdivision 10.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 122A.14, subdivision 10, is amended to read:

Subd. 10.
Principal preparation program reporting.
By December 31[-, 2018, and annually thereafter-][+ each year+], the Board of School Administrators shall report and publish on its website the cumulative summary results of three years of data reported to the board under section 122A.091, subdivision 1, for each principal preparation program.

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective July 1, 2025. +]
